newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps cuts First Union Real Estate.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps cuts First Union Real Estate.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it cut its long-term debt rating on First Union Real Estate & Mortgage Investments' $100 million 8.875 percent senior unsecured notes due 2003 to Double B Minus from Double B.
The rating company also has withdrawn its Double B rating on First Union's 8.6 percent senior notes due July 1, 1996. Those notes were repaid on their maturity date.
The rating action is a response to First Union's decreasing interest coverage, higher levels of mortgage debt and continued asset growth on a modest capital base.

While First Union has made progress in repositioning its somewhat older portfolio of retail, multifamily and office properties, asset growth and capital expenditures in recent years have been financed through increased borrowing, Duff & Phelps noted.
The downgrade follows First Union's June announcement that it would form a joint venture to acquire a portfolio of nine regional malls from Marathon U.S. Realties for $316 million.
